class.name: SuperpositionRPCMethod
class.brief_description: A typed, permission-checked network method rule.
class.description: One explicit RPC allowlist entry for [SuperpositionRPC]. Select a stable ID, exact target method name, sender permission, argument Variant types and call-rate limit. Matching peers must use the same complete method schema. Arbitrary method names received over the network are never invoked.

members.member: Exact ordered Variant types for up to eight arguments. Supported types are Boolean, integer, finite float, String (at most 256 UTF-8 bytes) and finite Vector3. No object or nested-container decoding is permitted.
Per-peer, per-method receive limit from 1 to 128 calls per one-second window. The RPC node also applies an aggregate peer limit and bounded dispatch queue.
Exact callable method name on the spawned scene root. Names must be unique, nonempty and at most 128 UTF-8 bytes.
Unique wire method identifier from 1 to 65535. Must be unique within the RPC allowlist.
Allowed sender role from [enum Permission]. Permission is checked against authenticated identity and the live target both before enqueueing and before dispatch.

constants.constant: Only the authoritative server may send this method to clients.
Only the authenticated client identity owning the target may send this method to the server. A reconnect is checked against its new live connection.
Any authenticated, schema-compatible sender may call the method on a live target. Application-specific validation remains the target method's responsibility.
